_doc: dialogue.json (AI-A). Interview templates for Sim.ask(pid,q). q=0 'Where did you last have it?' uses where_last (flavour + car hint); q=1 'What does it look like?' and q=2 'Anything special?' both reveal one hint attribute using attr_lines. Structure: ask_labels = [label for q0,q1,q2]; where_last.<mood> = lines with {car} (name of the car where the item lay, e.g. 'the Dining car') and optional {item}; attr_lines.<attr>.<mood> = lines with {value}; attrs: color|material|smell|sound|wear|initials|station_stamp; generic.<mood> = fallback for any other attr, uses {attr} and {value}; imposter.slip.<mood> = lines used instead of attr_lines when the imposter states the one WRONG detail (use {value} = the wrong value); imposter.too_perfect = over-rehearsed lines an imposter may add to the *right* details ({value}); imposter.deflect = what an imposter says when pressed with no answer; empty.<mood> = when there is nothing left to ask. Moods: calm|hurried|worried|shy|grumpy. Keys are stable: add lines freely, never rename keys.
ask_labels: Where did you last have it?

calm: I think I had it near {car}. I was reading, or napping. One of those.
Somewhere around {car}, I'd say. It was a pleasant afternoon.
Last I saw it, I was passing {car}. It waved. Figuratively.
hurried: {car}! I was in {car}! Or leaving it! Look there!
Near {car}, I think, I was in a rush, I'm always in a rush!
worried: Oh, I had it in {car}. I think. I do hope it's still there.
Somewhere near {car}. I put it down for just a second. Just one!
{car}, I believe. Please say it's safe.
shy: I was in {car}, mostly. Near the window. Sorry.
{car}, I think. It's a quiet spot. Sorry.
grumpy: I had it in {car} and then I didn't. Draw your own conclusions.
Somewhere in {car}. Check the seats. Check the culprits.

Mostly {value}. Dependably so.

{value}, I believe. Please let it still be {value}.
grumpy: {value}. Obviously. What else would it be?

calm: Made of {value}, I'm fairly sure.
It's {value}. Good and honest.

It felt like {value}. It always felt like {value}.

I remember {value}. It was so comforting.

{value}. Sniff it yourself if you doubt me.

Give it a shake. A {value}, you'll find.
worried: It makes a {value}. Oh, I do hope it still does.
There's a {value} inside. I'd know it anywhere.
grumpy: It goes {value}. Drove my neighbour mad.

calm: It's {value}, as is only proper after all these years.
Rather {value}, I'm afraid. Well loved.
worried: It's a bit {value}. I hope that doesn't matter.
{value}, I think. I never could take care of things.
shy: It's, um, {value}. Sorry. I use it a lot.
grumpy: {value}. Because I use it. Unlike some.

calm: There are initials on it. {value}, I believe.
Look for {value} stitched or scratched somewhere.
worried: It has {value} on it. Please check. I'd be lost without it. Lost-er.
I scratched {value} on it myself. Please.
shy: It says {value} on it. That's me. Sorry.
grumpy: Read the letters. {value}. Is that so hard?

calm: There's a stamp on it from {value}. Souvenir of a nice trip.
It bears a {value} stamp, I believe.
worried: I think it has a {value} stamp. Oh, please be right.
A stamp from {value}. I'm nearly sure.
shy: It, um, has a stamp from {value}. Sorry.

calm: Its {attr}? Why, {value}. Quite definitely.
{value}, regarding its {attr}.
worried: The {attr} is {value}, I think. I hope.
I remember the {attr}: {value}. Please.

calm: Oh, it's {value}. Quite certain. Quite.
It's definitely {value}. I know my things.
worried: It's {value}. It's {value}, isn't it? It's {value}.
{value}, I'm positive. Mostly positive.
shy: It's {value}. Sorry. I mean it is {value}.
grumpy: {value}, and don't give me that look.

too_perfect: Exactly {value}, precisely, down to the last detail.
I'd describe it as {value}, ahem, in every particular.
Oh yes, {value}, as I told the other attendant. And the one before.
{value}. I've said it so many times it's practically a hymn.
deflect: Does it matter? It's mine, that's what matters.
I'd rather not say. Sentimental reasons.
Why all the questions? Just hand it over.
Hm. I can't think. It's been a long day.

calm: I think I've told you everything.
That's all I remember, I'm afraid.
worried: I can't think of anything else. I'm so sorry.
That's everything, truly. Oh dear.
